title: Hunting Master
description: Become the ultimate hunter in Hunting Master, a fun and strategic archery shooting game set in a beautiful desert world! Jump between floating islands and use your bow to hunt wild animals like boars and wolves with precise shots. The core idea is aim, power, and chain reactions — shoot arrows to defeat animals and collect points while upgrading your bow with powerful abilities. What makes it unique? Stunning floating island visuals, satisfying bow-shooting mechanics with glowing effects, multiple power-ups (Meteorite, Thunder, etc.), and addictive progression as you become a stronger hunter in this desert hunting adventure!
